q: 2 copies of this card are in the battle area. Can I activate the
effects on both copies of this card, place 2 cards from my hand in digivolution cards, then digivolve that Digimon into a [DM] trait Digimon card with the digivolution cost reduced by 4?

Card Q&A.a: It refers to when you have the specified card in the battle area or breeding area.
Card Q&A.q: What does "while you have (the specified card) on the field" mean, exactly?

Effect: While you have a [DM] trait Digimon or Tamer on the field, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Main] ＜Draw 1＞. Then, place this card in the battle area.

・By placing 1 card from your hand face down as any of your [DM] trait Digimon's bottom digivolution card, it may digivolve into a [DM] trait Digimon card in the hand with the digivolution cost reduced by 2.
Security Effect: [Security] ＜Draw 1＞. Then, place this card in the battle area.
